scopeOfPassed: Offline polygon validity, explicit closure, bounded difference and preserved contour geometry only; does not assert electrical ground anchoring, DRC, or fabrication readiness.
preservationContract: Only listed FILL.path may change, after exact beforeBody guards. Other fields, all old outer boundaries and unaffected holes/arcs remain exact. Invalid geometry is never repaired. Stop each primitive if an outer boundary is touched.
limitations: Offline local copper subtraction only; parent must rebase exact source body guards after placement/cutback and check native readback geometry.
Does not prove every surviving ground region is MCU-VSS anchored; physical ground graph and strict unchanged-rule native DRC are separate mandatory gates.
Placement bounding rectangles are conservative copper supersets; no non-GND FILLs are changed by default.
